source: Five user-supplied images uploaded to the repository folder on 27 October 2026; original PNG bytes preserved.

illustrations.title: Elevated train and station
illustrations.alt: Wheel-supported train beside an elevated station with a solar canopy
illustrations.caption: A wheel-supported train on conventional rails beside an elevated station, with roof solar panels and a platform canopy.

illustrations.title: Accessible passenger interior
illustrations.alt: Seated passenger cabin with a wheelchair space beside the doors
illustrations.caption: A bright seated cabin with a wheelchair space beside the doors. Detailed seat counts, boarding clearances and restraints require the controlled layout.

illustrations.title: Local vehicle assembly
illustrations.alt: Exploded vehicle assembly in a workshop with roof, doors, seating and bogies
illustrations.caption: Workshop assembly concept showing the body, roof, glazing, doors, seating and bogies as separate assemblies.

illustrations.title: Precast guideway construction
illustrations.alt: Crane lifting a precast rail beam onto elevated piers
illustrations.caption: Illustrated precast-beam erection above an urban corridor. Lifting arrangements, temporary stability and site protection need their own engineered plans.

illustrations.title: Station LIM and passive secondary
illustrations.alt: Wheel bogies above a passive aluminium fin between two station LIM primaries
illustrations.caption: Passive wheel bogies support the car while station-side double-sided LIM primaries act on a passive aluminium fin. Blue arrows illustrate the propulsion concept.
